patch_description: Replace per-destination independent shortest paths with a shared Steiner tree approach. Broadcast data can be split across parallel paths: instead of sending all partitions of every destination along the same Dijkstra path (which duplicates transfers on shared links), we compute a low-cost Steiner tree connecting src to all dsts. Shared edges only need to be traversed once per partition, drastically reducing redundant transfers. For each partition, we use k-shortest-path candidates on the Steiner tree / residual graph to spread load and use parallel paths, balancing throughput. This reduces total cost (fewer redundant edge traversals) and improves load balance.
